## Demonic Knight (CR 12)

**XP 19,200  
** CE Medium outsider (chaotic, evil, extraplanar)  
 **Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +26  
 **Aura** fear (30 ft., DC 18)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 32, touch 15, flat-footed 31 (+1 dodge, +8 armor, +9 natural, +4 profane)  
 **hp** 135 (9d10+45)  
 **Fort** +11, **Ref** +4, **Will** +10  
 **DR** 10 cold iron or magic; **SR** 23  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft. (30 ft. base)  
 **Melee** +1 anarchic longsword +17/+12 (1d8+7/19–20) or 2 slams +15 (1d6+6)  
 **Special Attacks** breath of unlife, create spawn,  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 20th)  

  At will—*[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[see invisibility](../../magic/spells/see-invisibility.md)*, *[wall of ice](../../magic/spells/wall-of-ice.md)* (DC 18)  
 2/day—*[dispel magic](../../magic/spells/dispel-magic.md)*  
 1/day—*[fireball* ](../../magic/spells/fireball.md)(DC 17),[ *symbol of pain* ](../../magic/spells/symbol-of-pain.md)(DC 19), *[symbol of fear](../../magic/spells/symbol-of-fear.md)* (DC 20), *summon* (level 9, 1d4 shadow demons, 1 vrock or marilith, 2 glabrezus or hezrous 50%)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 22, **Dex** 13, **Con** 20, **Int** 18, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 18  
 **Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +15; **CMD** 31  
 **Feats** Alertness, Blind-Fight, Cleave, Weapon Focus (longsword), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Bluff +16, Climb +12, Diplomacy +16, Intimidate +16, Knowledge (planes) +16, Perception +26, Sense Motive +18, Spellcraft +13, Stealth +7, Survival +16; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Perception  
 **Languages** Abyssal, Common  
 **Gear** masterwork half-plate, *+1 anarchic longsword*  

**Special Abilities**

 **Breath of Unlife (Su)** Once every 1d4 rounds, the demonic knight can exhale a blast of negative energy in a 10-foot cone. Creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 20 Reflex save or take 2d4 points of Strength damage. A creature reduced to Strength 0 by a demonic knight dies. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

 **Create Spawn (Su)** Any humanoid slain by a demonic knight’s breath of unlife becomes a shadow demon in 2d4 rounds. Spawn are under the command of the demonic knight that created them and remain enslaved until its death. They do not possess any of the abilities they had in life.  

  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any (Abyss)  
 **Organization** solitary or troupe (demonic knight plus 2–4 shadow demons)  
 **Treasure** standard
